caption: Castello di Miramare, Trieste
composition: White neo-Gothic castle on Adriatic promontory · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The castle is seen from the coastal path that runs along the left of the frame, dark trees crowding its edge. The white neo-Gothic castle stands in the center on its rocky promontory, its windows and stonework floodlit, the sea cliffs dropping to the water below it. To the right the calm Adriatic stretches to the horizon under bands of pink and grey cloud. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 06:31 Europe/Rome: dawn twilight, the sun not yet risen, with the castle artificially lit.
